r17-how.title: How this round works: try it, tick it, sign it off
body: Everything from the last two rounds already has your answer, so the sheet looked empty. This round is a checklist instead: one card per new change, then one per part of the app, so you can walk through Shiftbook and sign each part off.

Each card lists a few things to try. Tick them as you go (they save straight away, and the card counts them). When a card is done, press **Approve**. If something didn't work, write it in the note and press **Needs changes**, and I'll pick it up.
The earlier cards are in the **Archive** tab, still searchable. Changes still waiting to be merged are marked **Not merged yet**, so try those once they are in the app.
r17-how.pick: Approve this card once you're happy with the checklist idea. Needs changes if you'd rather have it another way.
r17-how.note_hint: Anything about how this sheet works

r17-ticket-to-entry.title: Add a ticket card to an entry
body: On the Desk, a ticket from the Tickets tray can now be added to an entry. Right-click the ticket card and pick **Add to an entry**, then click the entry.
The ticket keeps its own minutes in the tray, and folds into the entry's tickets strip because they are the same work. Ticking it done on one ticks it on the other.

options.value: Right-click a tray ticket on the Desk and the menu shows Add to an entry
The Desk says "Click the entry to add …" and Esc cancels it
Clicking an entry adds the ticket number to that entry's tickets
The ticket's minutes stay the same in the tray (nothing is counted twice)
The ticket card folds into the entry's tickets strip
Ticking it done in one place shows it done in the other
Undo takes the ticket off the entry again
Clicking a card that isn't an entry shows a short message instead

r17-keep-spot.title: Logged jots and scraps keep their spot on the Desk
body: When a jot or an Inbox scrap becomes an entry, the new entry now appears exactly where the jot or scrap was, instead of jumping somewhere else. If the jot was in a pile, the entry goes into the same pile.

options.value: Right-click a jot on the Desk → Log it as an entry: the entry shows up where the jot was
A jot inside a pile becomes an entry in the same pile
Undo brings the jot back to the same place
An Inbox scrap's Log it on the Desk: the new entry lands where the scrap was
Logging a scrap onto an entry that already exists doesn't move that entry
A jot filed in a drawer still logs fine (it just has no spot to keep)
